Reference list

Battilana, J. and Dorado, S. (2010) ‘Building sustainable hybrid organizations: the case of commercial microfinance organizations’, Academy of Management Journal, 53(6), pp. 1419–1440.
Dacin, P.A., Dacin, M.T. and Matear, M. (2010) ‘Social entrepreneurship: why we don’t need a new theory and how we move forward from here’, Academy of Management Perspectives, 24(3), pp. 37–57.
Mair, J. and Martí, I. (2006) ‘Social entrepreneurship research: a source of explanation, prediction, and delight’, Journal of World Business, 41(1), pp. 36–44.
Oliver, C. 1991, ‘Strategic responses to institutional processes’, Academy of Management Review, vol. 16, no. 1, pp. 145–179.
Ostrom, E. (1990) Governing the commons: the evolution of institutions for collective action. Cambridge: Cambridge University Press.
Pache, A.-C. and Santos, F. (2013) ‘Inside the hybrid organization: selective coupling as a response to competing institutional logics’, Academy of Management Journal, 56(4), pp. 972–1001.
Suchman, M.C. (1995) ‘Managing legitimacy: strategic and institutional approaches’, Academy of Management Review, 20(3), pp. 571–610.
Thornton, P.H., Ocasio, W. and Lounsbury, M. 2012, The institutional logics perspective: a new approach to culture, structure and process, Oxford University Press, Oxford.
World Economic Forum (2012) From the margins to the mainstream: assessment of the impact investment sector and opportunities to engage mainstream investors. Geneva: World Economic Forum.
Zahra, S.A., Gedajlovic, E., Neubaum, D.O. and Shulman, J.M. (2009) ‘A typology of social entrepreneurs: motives, search processes and ethical challenges’, Journal of Business Venturing, 24(5), pp. 519–532.
